title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards New Cardmember Offer: Welcome Discount Terms
content:
**Offer.** A newly approved Marlowe & Finch Store Card, Marlowe & Finch Mastercard or Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard account receives the card's welcome discount percent off Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to it.

**Time condition.** The purchase date falls within the welcome window that starts on the account's opened date. The window runs from the opened date (day 1) through the day before the opened date plus the card's welcome window in calendar days, so that a purchase dated on that later day is outside it. The opened date and the purchase date are read from the company's account and transaction records.

**Amount.** The discount is taken on the pre-discount purchase amount, rounded half up to the cent, and the discounts across all purchases in the window together never exceed the card's welcome discount cap; the purchase that reaches the cap receives only the remainder. The discount is recorded on the purchase as its welcome discount amount, and the amount charged is the pre-discount amount less that discount.

**Where it does not apply.** It does not apply to outside-merchant purchases, gift card purchases, or purchases on an account reached by status upgrade. It is a new-cardmember offer: it is not given when the customer held another Marlowe & Finch card account in active or restricted status on the application date (combination exclusion between the two networks). A later return of a discounted purchase refunds only the amount actually charged; the discount is never re-granted.

## Window boundary (hypothetical account opened on the 10th of a month, card window of 2 calendar days)

| Purchase dated | Day of the window | Inside the window |
|---|---|---|
| the 10th (opened date) | day 1 | yes |
| the 11th | day 2 | yes |
| the 12th (opened date plus 2 days) | — | no |

## Worked amounts (hypothetical card: 10 percent, cap USD 50.00)

| Purchase in the window | Pre-discount amount | Discount found | Cap left before | Discount recorded | Amount charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| first | USD 333.33 | USD 33.33 (33.333 rounded) | USD 50.00 | USD 33.33 | USD 300.00 |
| second | USD 250.00 | USD 25.00 | USD 16.67 | USD 16.67 | USD 233.33 |
| third | USD 40.00 | USD 4.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 40.00 |

If the second purchase is later returned, the refund is USD 233.33, the amount actually charged, and its USD 16.67 discount is not re-granted to a later purchase.
